reserves.name: EUR cash and permitted HQLA reserve basket at EU CRR credit institutions
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Undisclosed EU CRR credit institutions and permitted HQLA issuers

reserveReview.rationale: AllUnity describes EURAU as fully backed by reserves held at EU CRR credit institutions in segregated accounts, with 1:1 redemption. The Trust Center states the reserve audit report is 'coming soon' and does not publish a dated cash/HQLA split, bank identities, or provider shares. Because the disclosed envelope is entirely euro-denominated bank reserves/HQLA at regulated EU institutions, the whole reserve is classified as a single very-low-risk bank-deposit slice rather than left unresolved.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: AllUnity EURAU trust-center and white-paper reserve envelope (full euro bank-reserve backing, no published instrument split)
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No material reserve asset class is unclassified; individual bank identities, provider shares, cash/HQLA split, maturities, and rehypothecation terms are not disclosed.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: AllUnity discloses EU CRR credit-institution custody and segregation, and the white paper describes insolvency remoteness; bank identities, provider shares, and rehypothecation terms are not disclosed.
